verdict.rationale: Cooley GO offers some non-US, jurisdiction-specific instruments: UK and Singapore versions of the YC Safe and a UK mutual NDA. The firm also has a London office, and the HN post says Cooley GO publishes posts on equity incentive tax issues, though not tied to any non-US market. However, nothing in the evidence shows publications on the named instruments or local rules, and the France practice page excerpts only describe S-1 drafting tooling. Missing for 10: guidance on UK EMI schemes, German VSOPs, Indian FDI/ESOP rules and French BSPCE; non-US equity-incentive content; independent corroboration of cross-border startup publishing.
